review_description: He gave me the choice of different types of systems.He explained to me pros and cons for each system.Being a local installer and his customer service was excellent.Was able to attend my property and show me how and what all the issues we may face.Has completed all required paperwork to ensure a smooth transition.

Installer is informative and easy to talk to.  Answered all questions to my satisfaction. Openly gave his recommendations and opinions re system design/type and roof location. Completed all necessary paperwork.  Explained time frames and system operation.

Very good, honest competent, and professional installation.  Delays have been experienced with getting the system in service weeks after but that has been due to delays by electricity distributor and electricity retaier.  Nothing to do with installation. Very pleased with standard of work by installer.
Matt is a reliable and careful electrician who I would recommend to anyone wanting a system installed.
